output: {"answers":{"d05":"检测呈阳性后，你真正关心的患病概率并不等于检测准确率，还取决于这种病的基率。假设患病率1%，检测对病人有99%的把握报阳，但对健康人也有5%误报。看10000人：约100人生病，其中99人报阳；其余9990人健康，约500人被误报。所以全部阳性约599人，真正生病的只占99/599≈六分之一。贝叶斯公式就是这步的通用写法：P(患病|阳性) = P(阳性|患病)×P(患病) ÷ P(阳性)，分子是「生病且被查出」的人数，分母是所有报阳的人（含误报）。注意方向：「有病的人里多少报阳」和「报阳的人里多少有病」是两个不同的比例，混掉它们正是高估风险的根源。基率越低，同一个阳性越可能只是误报。","d03":"正反馈是输出的结果又回到输入端，把原来的变化推得更大：A增强B，B反过来让A更强。麦克风对准音箱，一点噪音被放大后播出，又被麦克风拾取，循环几圈就成了啸叫；存款生利息，利息并入本金再生更多利息，也是同一结构。它放大的方向与好坏是两回事：口碑传播、复利是受人欢迎的正反馈；发烧时的体温失控、银行的挤兑是害人的正反馈——评价好坏要看放大的是什么，而不是机制本身。另外，持续放大需要每圈增益大于1，而且不会无限继续：音箱功率、市场容量最终会把变化压到上限（饱和）。所以正反馈改变的是变化的速度，不等于好事，也不保证无限增长。","v08":"Little's law says: in a stable queueing system, the average number of items inside equals the arrival rate times the average time each item spends there: L = λW. If a coffee shop takes in 10 customers per minute (λ) and each spends 4 minutes inside on average (W), then at any moment about 40 customers are inside (L = 10 × 4). The payoff is that you can compute the one you can't measure from the two you can: 40 people inside with 10 arriving per minute means each is spending 4 minutes waiting plus being served. Two conditions matter. The system must be stable — arrivals must not exceed capacity, or the line grows without bound and averages never settle. And all three numbers must be long-run averages for the same system, in consistent time units.","v03":"自然选择改变种群，靠的不是生物主动努力，而是已有的随机变异被环境筛选：某些性状恰好让携带者留下更多后代，下一代里这些性状的比例就升高。长颈鹿的脖子不是「够着够着就长了」——古代鹿群里天生有高有矮，干旱年份矮个够不到叶子，高的吃得饱、孩子多，后代里高脖子的比例就一代代上升。关键有三点：变异是随机产生的，先于环境的需要出现；选择只筛掉不合适的现成变异，不能「想要」什么就造出什么；被改变的是种群中性状的比例，个体的特征终生不变。所以进化是被动筛选的结果，不是主动奋斗的目标。","v06":"Deadlock is when processes each hold a resource and wait forever for the other's, so none can proceed. Example: Transaction 1 locks row A, then wants row B; Transaction 2 locks row B, then wants row A. T1 waits for B, T2 waits for A, and neither will release what it holds until it finishes — which it now can't. Four conditions must all hold: resources are exclusive, holders keep them while waiting for more, nothing can be forcibly taken away, and the waits form a circle. Break any one and deadlock disappears. Practical fixes: acquire locks in a fixed global order (no circle can form), detect the cycle and abort one victim so its locks are released, or use timeouts so stuck transactions give up and retry.","v05":"信息熵衡量「平均有多难猜」：对每个可能结果，用它的概率 p 算 −p·log p，再全部加起来。概率越小的结果出现时越让人惊讶，log 把这种惊讶放大；乘上 p 又按出现频率加权，所以熵是按真实分布平均后的惊讶量。均匀分布最不确定，是因为每个结果概率一样大，观察之前你没有任何偏重可用——猜哪个都一样没把握。一旦分布偏斜，不确定性立刻下降：均匀硬币的熵是1比特；一枚99%出正面的硬币，闭眼猜「正面」就有99%胜算，熵只剩约0.08比特。注意前提：「均匀最不确定」是在结果个数给定的条件下成立的结论，比较两个分布的熵时也要在同一组结果上比。","v01":"过拟合是模型把训练数据里的偶然噪声也当成了规律，结果在见过的题目上表现极好，换新数据就露馅。用考试类比：一个学生不整理方法，把每道练习题连答案带出题顺序都背下来，平时模拟满分，高考换个数字就懵——他背的是这批题的偶然特征，不是解题方法。机器学习里同样的事：模型越复杂，越能把训练样本一个个「记住」，训练准确率逼近100%，预测新样本反而更差。判断标准很明确：看没见过的数据上的表现，而不是训练数据。常见对策是给更多样化的数据，或限制模型复杂度，逼它只学得动规律、学不动噪声。","d01":"似然回答的是：假定某个假设为真，眼前这批数据出现的可能性有多大，记作 P(数据|假设)。它不是「假设为真的概率」，方向别弄反。掷一枚硬币10次出9次正面：若正面率是0.5，这批结果的似然是 C(10,9)×0.5^10≈0.0098；若正面率是0.9，似然是 C(10,9)×0.9^9×0.1≈0.387。似然就是这样横向比较的：固定同一批数据，看哪个假设让它显得更不意外。后验概率回答另一个问题：看过数据后，这个假设本身有多可信，即 P(假设|数据)。贝叶斯公式把两者连起来：后验 ∝ 似然 × 先验，先验是看数据前你对假设的信心。似然再大也只是数据提供的支持度，要乘上先验才得到假设为真的概率。","d07":"相关不等于因果，因为两个量一起变，还可能来自共同原因、反过来影响或纯属巧合。看一个具体例子：冰淇淋销量高的月份，溺水人数也多，二者明显相关。但吃冰淇淋不会淹死人，真相是第三个因素——夏天气温高——同时推高了两者：天热人们多买冰淇淋，也多去游泳，溺水随之增加。这叫混杂因素，它藏在背后，露出来的只有相关。要判断因果，需要追问机制（冰淇淋如何导致溺水？说不出来）、做控制（在同一气温下比较，相关通常消失）、检查时间顺序（原因须在前），最可靠的是随机分组做实验。以后看到「A与B相关」，先问：有没有C同时影响两者？这个结论经得起实验检验吗？","d02":"Variance measures how spread out numbers are around their average: the mean of squared deviations. Take 2, 4, 6 with mean 4. Each number deviates by −2, 0, +2. If you averaged the deviations themselves, they'd cancel to zero and tell you nothing — so we square each one first: 4, 0, 4, then average: 8/3 ≈ 2.67. That's the population variance, dividing by N because these are all the numbers. Squaring solves cancellation but does two more things: it treats deviations above and below the mean identically, and it punishes large deviations disproportionately — one value far from the mean raises variance much more than several slightly-off values do. Since squaring changes units, the square root (standard deviation, here ≈ 1.63) is what you compare against the original data's scale.","d08":"Compound growth means growth earns growth: each period's gain is added to the base, so the next period's percentage applies to a bigger amount. A = P(1+r)^t: start with 1,000 at 10% a year and after 10 years you have 1,000 × 1.1^10 ≈ 2,594, not the 2,000 that simple linear growth would give. The starting amount matters because the formula multiplies: the same rate applied to a bigger base yields proportionally bigger absolute gains — 2,000 under the same terms becomes about 5,188 while 1,000 becomes 2,594. Time matters even more: the same 1,000 at 10% for 30 years reaches about 17,450, because each decade compounds on everything before it. Starting earlier buys more doubling periods; starting with more simply scales the whole curve upward.","d06":"Cache invalidation is deciding when a stored copy of data no longer matches the source and must be deleted or refreshed. A web app caches a product's price so each page view doesn't hit the database. When the store updates that price, every cached copy is now wrong — the app must invalidate it (delete it so the next request reloads fresh data) or it will show customers outdated prices. Common strategies: a TTL gives each entry an expiry time — simple, but stale data can be served until it fires; write-through updates the cache whenever the database changes; invalidate-on-write deletes the entry and lets the next read repopulate it. The hard part is knowing reliably when the underlying data changed, in every place it was cached — which is why this is a famously hard problem.","v04":"Idempotency means performing the same operation any number of times has the same effect as performing it once. It matters in distributed systems because networks are unreliable: when a request times out, you can't tell whether it succeeded, so clients retry — and retries are normal, not exceptional. Compare two endpoints: \"add 1 to the balance\" is not idempotent; three retries charge three times. \"Set order status to shipped\" is idempotent; retrying changes nothing. The standard fix is an idempotency key: the client attaches a unique ID to each operation, the server records it, and a duplicate request with the same key returns the original result instead of re-executing. Designing handlers so any retried request is safe is a core discipline for distributed APIs.","v02":"Precision and recall answer two different questions about a search. Suppose your query returns 10 documents, 8 of them relevant, and you know 20 relevant documents exist in total. Precision = 8/10 = 0.8: of what you showed me, how much was actually relevant — it measures junk. Recall = 8/20 = 0.4: of everything relevant out there, how much did you find — it measures misses. The two trade off. Return everything and recall hits 1.0 while precision drops as junk floods in; return only the single document you're surest of and precision approaches 1.0 while recall collapses. Which to prioritize depends on which mistake costs more: spam filtering punishes junk (false positives), medical screening punishes missed cases (false negatives).","d04":"Opportunity cost is the value of the best thing you give up when you choose. You have a free afternoon: hike, study for Monday's exam, or nap. If you pick the hike, the cost isn't all three others — only the single best alternative you sacrificed, say studying. If studying was worth more to you than the hike, the hike cost you more than it gave. A free afternoon isn't free: even though no money changes hands, spending it one way means not spending it another way. Two things beginners miss: only the best forgone option counts, since you couldn't have done all of them anyway; and the comparison uses your own values — for one person the best alternative is rest, for another it's study. Weigh each choice against its best rival, not against doing nothing.","v07":"公共物品有两个特征：不排他（没法把不付钱的人挡在外面）和不拥挤（多一人享用不减少别人的份）。路灯、国防、干净的空气都是。搭便车是随之而来的行为：不掏钱照样享受，于是理性的个人都等着别人出钱。整栋楼集资换楼道灯，出钱的人发现不出钱的邻居灯光照用，下次自己也不愿掏——结果是人人都想要路灯，人人都不付钱，灯就装不起来。这正是市场供给公共物品会不足的原因：卖商品能向使用者收钱，路灯这类东西却收不到。常见解法靠强制或变通：用税收供养国防和路灯；把可排他的部分圈起来收费（如收费公路）；或靠声望、道德这类回报，让贡献者得到别的好处。"}}
